say:3:1322048002:1.text: That's right! It was fun, fun, fun! There were new playmates this time—ones I've never seen before!
say:3:1322048002:1.source_cn: 没错没错，玩的可开心！但是这次有新人来，新的没见过，更...

say:4:1322048003:1.text: New playmates...? Yet you are injured. What has happened?
say:4:1322048003:1.source_cn: 新人……？不对，你受伤了。这是怎么回事？

choice_prompt:5:1322048003.text: New playmates...? Yet you are injured. What has happened?
choice_prompt:5:1322048003.source_cn: 新人……？不对，你受伤了。这是怎么回事？

say:6:1322048004:1.text: Shemira was amazing. It was so fun to fight with her, but she doesn't want to play—she just wants to punish. And that's no fun for anyone!
say:6:1322048004:1.source_cn: 雪米拉很厉害，和她打架很有趣！但她不想玩耍，只想惩罚，...

say:7:1322048005:1.text: You spoke of Shemira... Might it indeed be her...?
say:7:1322048005:1.source_cn: 你们说那个新来的亡灵叫雪米拉？难道……

choice_prompt:8:1322048005.text: You spoke of Shemira... Might it indeed be her...?
choice_prompt:8:1322048005.source_cn: 你们说那个新来的亡灵叫雪米拉？难道……

say:9:1322048006:0.text: By happenstance, a new Graveborn has appeared at Sorrowfall Lake. His name is <style="highlight">Niru</style>, a battlefield healer who seeks to understand the power of the soul.
say:9:1322048006:0.source_cn: 说来也巧，最近哀叹之湖这里也来了一位新的亡灵，他叫<s...

say:10:1322048007:1.text: He was drawn by the undead who dwell there and now seeks to uncover how to awaken their memories and grant them peace.
say:10:1322048007:1.source_cn: 他被这里的活死人吸引，正在研究如何唤起活死人的记忆，让...

say:11:1322048008:1.text: You are well aware that it has ever been my desire to guide my comrades to peace. Thus, I have kept watch over his research, and from time to time, I inquire of his progress.
say:11:1322048008:1.source_cn: 你们知道，能够让我的战友们重归平静一直是我的心愿。所以...

say:12:1322048009:0.text: Niru said he came to Whiteridge with his family. His son is in poor health, and his wife, so distraught over their child's state, joined him here to partake in his research—though I have not yet made her acquaintance.
say:12:1322048009:0.source_cn: 他曾提到，他和家人一起来到白山。不过他的儿子身体很差，...

say:13:1322048010:1.text: Yet, from what he has shared with me, her name is Shemira...
say:13:1322048010:1.source_cn: 但是从他的口中，我听过雪米拉的名字……

say:16:1322048011:0.text: A wife who is distraught over their child and a son who is in poor health... Yep, that sounds like Shemira and Daimon.
say:16:1322048011:0.source_cn: 过度关心孩子的妻子，还有身体不好的儿子……听起来很像是...

say:19:1322048012:0.text: What a strange family! They should know that families should play together!
say:19:1322048012:0.source_cn: 奇奇怪怪的一家人！一家人应该一起玩才对！

say:20:1322048013:1.text: If this Lady Shemira is indeed Niru's wife, then the matter that troubles you so may be swiftly resolved.
say:20:1322048013:1.source_cn: ……如果那位名叫雪米拉的亡灵女士确实是尼汝的妻子，那你...

say:21:1322048014:1.text: Niru should be at the <style="highlight">ancient ruins</style>, deep in his research. Come, I shall lead you to him, and we may speak at length.
say:21:1322048014:1.source_cn: 尼汝应该还在<style=highlight>古军营遗...

say:22:1322048015:1.text: Igor, rest and heal your wounds. Do not wander far, and above all, do not venture back to Cedartown anytime soon.
say:22:1322048015:1.source_cn: 伊戈尔，你就好好休息养伤吧，别乱跑了。尤其近期不要再去...

say:23:1322048016:1.text: Hmph! You're as boring as Shemira!
say:23:1322048016:1.source_cn: 哼，你说的话变得和雪米拉一样无聊了！

say:24:1322048017:1.text: ...Wait but a fortnight. When the dust settles, Carolina and I will accompany you to catch butterflies in the field of flowers. You have my word.
say:24:1322048017:1.source_cn: ……等两周。事件平息之后，我和卡列琳娜一起陪你去花海捉...

say:25:1322048018:1.text: Yes! That's perfect! Butterflies are like will-o'-wisps, but for the daytime—just as pretty!
say:25:1322048018:1.source_cn: ——喔，好！蝴蝶好，和鬼火一样漂亮，但是只有白天才有！

say:26:1322048019:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time, you have to come play with me too! Out of everyone, you're the most fun, no matter how much trouble you stir up!

say:28:1322048020:3.text: Igor does really seem like a child. He never seems to worry about anything.
say:28:1322048020:3.source_cn: 伊戈尔先生真的像个小孩子，好像从来都不会发愁呢……

say:29:1322048021:1.text: It is no simple task to tend to Igor's temperament while ensuring others are not struck with fear.
say:29:1322048021:1.source_cn: ……既要照顾伊戈尔的心情，又要保护别人不被惊吓，也不是...

say:30:1322048022:1.text: Very well. Let us depart. I shall lead you to Niru.
say:30:1322048022:1.source_cn: 好了，各位，走吧。我带你们去找尼汝军医。
